model.name: collectionChildren.includeParentLinkedFolders
model.description: The model-collection children derivation (server.ts children resolver for rawbin:<collection>, e.g. rawbin:diagram) surfaces ior:class:Folder units parented under the collection (parent=rawbin:<collection>) BY PARENT LINK, not only by filesystem location and not filtered to ior:class:Diagram — so a store-only Folder added to a model collection RENDERS as its child and persists. Ties offered<=>visible (Bug c83c02f2).
model.note: Architect wires Class (the mof children resolver / ScenarioIndex byParent) + Method on build-go, then re-inspects; sequences vs R40.87 routing (87 stops error, 92 makes visible).
